text:
The dish is a paper plate about 22 cm across, which is roughly 250 px in the image, so about 0.088 cm per px... more precisely 11.4 px per cm.

It holds three avocado wedges, each about 6.5–7 cm long, 2.5–3 cm wide and around 2 cm thick.

I estimate each wedge at 40–50 g of flesh. The photo shows the wedges with their skin on, so the total is about 130 g, or about 110 g if the skin and pit weight are excluded.

Avocado has about 1.6 kcal/g. At 120 g that gives roughly 190 kcal.
